messages:
nina: Heads-up: production audit shows downstream services losing original caller identity when requests are proxied through gateway. We only see gateway principal.

sam: Which header are we relying on currently?

nina: `X-RW-Actor` today; gateways replace it with their own.

jules: Two pragmatic paths: 1) append-only actor-chain header (cheap), 2) delegation JWT signed by caller and verified by downstreams (stronger).

sam: Prefer JWT for security, but verify cost is real. We can cache verifications with an LRU and use ED25519.

nina: Proposal: add `X-RW-Actor-Orig`, `X-RW-Actor-Chain`, and `X-RW-Delegation-JWT`. Downstreams treat Orig as authoritative only if JWT validates.

jules: Also require `scope` claim in JWT to avoid org->project escalation. Add `sig_kid` header for key lookup.

infra-bot: Created canary: gateway-delegation-canary-2026-03-22. Logs: /infra/canaries/delegation.
